title: Rav Shmuel bar Chiyya

paragraphs: He spoke in the name of Rabbi Elazar ([Bava Metzia 72b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.72b.16)), and in the name of Rabbi Mani ([Chullin 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.56b.7)); the source also has א׳.[^1]

notes.text: Bava Metzia gives Rabbi Shmuel speaking in the name of Rabbi Elazar. Chullin gives Rav Shmuel speaking in the name of Rabbi Mani. The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=303) has א׳, possibly referring to the opening word אדומין, “red organs.”
